headline: Modern Controls and Steam Deck Pack 0.3.0 join the launcher mod index
summary: The mod index now lists momo1212221's external Modern Controls and Steam Deck Pack mods for Ratchet & Clank PAL and NTSC-U, with version 0.3.0 approved for both (#48, #49, #53). Modern Controls offers direct mouse and controller camera control, axis sensitivity, deadzone and movement adjustments. The experimental Steam Deck Pack offers built-in white button prompts, Steam Input gyro and trackpad camera controls, and in-game settings.
highlights: The original proposals to add these mods inside this repository closed without merging (#43, #44). Their external listings landed instead (#48, #49).
A proposed Multiplayer 0.8.0 adds teammate rescue, host rally points and team tools. It remains unmerged (#45).
A Restored Debug Menu listing is awaiting review (#64, #63). Submissions also opened for QoL Hub, Fast Travel and Save Manager (#58, #59, #60).

Accessibility Pack proposes hold-to-mash controls (#61). Cutscene Manager proposes skipping only repeated scenes established as safe after natural completion (#62). These submissions are not approved listings yet.
New listing pull requests and review issues now notify maintainers when approval is needed (#50).
